patch_description: Instead of random points, place 14 points on the unit sphere and run a constrained SLSQP optimization that maximizes the minimum pairwise distance t (with t an extra variable and 91 pair constraints t ≤ ||pi-pj||). The diameter constraint is handled by normalizing the final configuration by its max pairwise distance, giving the ratio dmin/dmax. A few random restarts with fixed seeds make it robust; this typically reaches squared ratios near the reference 1/4.1658 ≈ 0.24 (vs 0.00 currently).
